subject: general
question: The price of 4 pens and 5 notebooks is Rs. 130. If the price of a pen is increases by 25% and the price of the notebook decreases by 20%, then the price of 2 pens and 4 notebooks becomes Rs. 82. What is the original price of 1 pen and 2 notebooks?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Let pen price = P, notebook price = N. Initial: 4P + 5N = 130 New price equation: 2 × (1.25P) + 4 × (0.8N) = 82 ⇒ 2.5P + 3.2N = 82 Multiply new equation by 1.6 to equate P: 4P + 5.12N = 131.2 Subtracting initial from new: 0.12N = 1.2 ⇒ N = 10 Substitute N = 10: 4P + 50 = 130 ⇒ 4P = 80 ⇒ P = 20 **∴ The correct answer is Rs. 40.**
